snippet.title: My Many Masks Early Demo Teaser
snippet.description:
A short teaser for my university final major project, My Many Masks!

A 2.5D, Sidescrolling Platformer with a hand-drawn, doodle art style, that focuses on the abilities of six different coloured masks and forming bonds with the NPCs you meet along the way.

This is mainly a proof of concept, with a massive rework planned to make this game what I truly want it to be. But rest assured, I don't want this game to end here.

You can download the demo from my itch.io page:
https://choosbeh.itch.io/my-many-masks-demo-version
